executive_summary: The NA Core Spanish Voice queue recorded an actual offered volume of 8,805 contacts against a forecast of only 90.8, driving forecast adherence to -9,599.7% – far beyond the ±10% threshold. The figure is isolated, returns to normal in the following weeks, and the same directional miss is already present at the Region level, indicating the issue is not unique to this queue. Before any forecasting action can be taken, the recorded volume must be validated at source; if confirmed, the miss stems from a higher‑level (Region) demand surge combined with a forecast plan restatement and the queue’s chronic over‑forecast bias.
business_impact: The massive under‑forecast would leave the queue severely understaffed, risking long wait times, abandoned contacts, overtime, and potential SLA breaches if the volume were real.

ranked_root_causes.title: Forecast plan restatement altered baseline

ranked_root_causes.recommended_action: Compare the FY27 May and FY27 Jun Projection assumptions (especially ASU and contact‑rate) for this queue to detect any baseline shift.

ranked_root_causes.title: Queue’s chronic over‑forecast bias
ranked_root_causes.explanation: Historically this queue tends to over‑forecast (positive adherence), indicating a standing bias in the forecasting process that may have contributed to the extreme miss when actual demand surged volume arrived.
ranked_root_causes.business_impact: Unadjusted bias will continue to produce forecast errors unless the model is recalibrated.
ranked_root_causes.recommended_action: Review and recalibrate the forecasting model for NA Core Spanish to remove the persistent over‑forecast tendency.
